errors.what: Wheel does not index by a net 90 deg step per driver revolution. Its angle swings 135 -> ~132 -> 180 (slots appear as a '+') at driver 0 and then back to 137.6 -> 135, so it oscillates back and forth instead of advancing one step in one direction (clockwise for a CCW driver). The indexing window is also only about 45 deg of wheel motion, not 90 deg, and at t=0 the wheel angle of 180 deg is inconsistent with a symmetric engagement around driver angle 0.

At t=0 the pin sits near the wheel centre, far inside the slot, and the slots are shown in a '+' orientation with the pin not in a slot at the rim. This is geometrically inconsistent with a proper Geneva engagement.
